name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
author: Netlens
description: Reads a Palo Alto Networks firewall (PAN-OS 9.0+, XML API with a read-only API key): the firewall as the gateway node with its interfaces, the devices behind it (DHCP leases and ARP table) with name and address, and its health: high availability, IPsec tunnels, firmware and licence expiry. Read-only: only operational 'show' commands.

info.title: Set up the firewall (once)
info.text: Create an administrator role that can only use the XML API for operational requests and read the system, then an administrator with that role, and generate its API key. Device > Admin Roles > Add: tick only XML API > Operational Requests (and Configuration: off), plus Web UI / CLI: none. Device > Administrators > Add, with that role. Then get the key once (change the password and address); keep it out of shared documents:

config.label: Firewalls
config.help: One line per firewall. For a high-availability pair, list the active unit's management address or each unit by itself. Point it at the firewall, not at Panorama.

columns.label: Role
columns.help: auto: the first firewall is the gateway of the network, any other one is shown as a node below it.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Untick it only when the firewall still uses its self-signed certificate. The key travels in a request header.
